name: Divoom Pixoo 64
description: Show your FiestaBoard pages on a Divoom Pixoo 64 LED matrix over your local network.
author: FiestaBoard Team

host.title: Device address
host.description: The Pixoo 64's IP address or hostname on your network (for example 192.168.1.50). Use Find my Pixoo, or type it in.

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.description: Screen brightness from 0 to 100. Leave empty to keep the device's own setting.

mac.title: Device MAC address
mac.description: Optional. Filled in by the Divoom cloud lookup so the lookup can find this Pixoo again if its IP address changes. 12 hex digits.

actions.label: Find my Pixoo
actions.description: Looks for a Pixoo 64 on your local network. Only devices on your network are contacted.

subnet.title: Network to search
subnet.description: Optional, for example 192.168.1.0/24. Leave empty to search the network FiestaBoard is on.

hint_host.title: Address you opened FiestaBoard at
hint_host.description: Optional. The network of this address is searched first.

actions.label: Ask Divoom's servers which Pixoos are on your network
actions.description: Sends one request to Divoom's cloud (app.divoom-gz.com). Divoom sees your public IP address and answers with the Pixoos registered from it. If this board has a saved MAC address, it finds that Pixoo again at its current address. Use this only if Find my Pixoo finds nothing.
